name: Boardable
description: Boardable is a board management platform for meetings, agendas, minutes, board packets, documents, discussions, polls, votes, tasks, goals, people, governance forms, surveys, reporting, and public meeting sites.
agentUseSummary: Boardable documents user-driven integrations that bring Zoom, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Google Drive, and Dropbox into its product, but no customer-authorized Boardable API or hosted MCP contract. Its current end-user terms also restrict automated accounts, robots, retrieval tools, and reverse engineering, so Relay mounts no connection or tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Boardable's public help center documents user-driven connections in which Boardable accesses Zoom, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Google Drive, and Dropbox. It does not publish an external customer authorization method, organization or API origin, least-privilege scope or role model for automation, endpoint or tool schema, pagination, rate limits, webhooks, rotation, revocation, disconnect, or non-production contract. References to mobile API endpoints in release notes describe Boardable's own applications, not a distributable customer API. Current end-user terms prohibit automated account creation, robots or retrieval applications, and reverse engineering, so browser or private-endpoint automation is not an acceptable fallback.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Boardable login credentials or show Connect, and do not automate the web, desktop, or mobile clients. Reconsider Boardable only after Boardable publishes or contractually supplies a distributable customer API or hosted MCP contract with compatible automation terms, exact organization and server origins, authentication, least-privilege permissions, tools or endpoints and schemas, pagination and rate limits, webhook behavior, credential rotation and revocation, disconnect semantics, and non-production test access.

evidence.supports: Boardable's current user settings document only user-driven connections to Zoom, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive or SharePoint, and Google Drive, with authorization performed through the product UI.

Boardable documents inbound Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and SharePoint file connections with product-specific copy, live-sync, editing, packet, comment, and folder limitations rather than an external Boardable account API.

Boardable documents layered organization, group, meeting, attendee, observer, collaborator, owner, administrator, and guest permissions, making undocumented automation over a general user session unsafe.

Boardable's administrator export surface includes documents, people, attendance, assignments, full discussion text, goals, meetings, compiled documents, and poll votes, demonstrating the sensitive breadth that Relay must not infer access to.
Boardable's current end-user terms prohibit automated account creation, robots or retrieval applications, reverse engineering, unauthorized access, and collecting or publishing user information.

Boardable's current privacy policy covers customer-controlled board member and participant data, contact, professional, demographic, profile, and AI-processed information, supporting a critical risk classification and the decision not to infer undocumented access.
